subs.title: Enter subscription identifiers
subs.description:
The WeChat-central gateway cannot auto-discover subscriptions, so please enter them manually:
- **subs_id**: required, used to read the current meter reading (core sensor);
- **subs_code / org_code**: optional; only when filled will bill history and balance be fetched.
Find subs_code / org_code in the Towngas WeChat mini-program, on the My Accounts page.
